en: Two-view color postcard from a Romanian seaside resort. The top image shows a modernist high-rise hotel with balconies and a ground-floor sign reading "COMPLEXUL U.G.S.R."; people, a horse-drawn carriage, a car and a yellow bus are in front. The bottom image shows a crowded Black Sea beach with breakwaters. The reverse has a Romanian printed template from the trade-union tourist network, a green 10 lei Posta Romana stamp, Bucharest postmark from early November 1972, and a handwritten Romanian message addressed to Bucharest.
